blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano on Friday criticized netizens and television news anchors over their comments on his proposal for voluntary contributions of P170,000 to help pay the country’s national debt, saying they had misunderstood his suggestion. During the Senate plenary deliberations on the proposed 2027 budget of the Department of National Defense, Cayetano took issue with social media users and news anchors who questioned what ordinary Filipinos could buy with P170,000, pointing out that his proposal was not intended for those struggling to make ends meet. “There are some who posted on Facebook, ‘Anong mabibili ng P170,000?
